vv34:1.1: [FOOTNOTES] [FOOTNOTES] Daddallamānā vaṇṇena yasasā ca yasassinī sabbe deve Tāvatiṃse vaṇṇena atirocasi. || ||
vv34:2.1: Dassanaṃ nābhijānāmi idaṃ paṭhamadassanaṃ kasmā kāyā nu āgamma nāmena bhāsase maman ti. || ||
vv34:3.1: Ahaṃ bhadde Subhaddāsiṃ pubbe mānusake bhave sahabhariyā ca te āsiṃ bhaginī ca kaniṭṭhikā. || ||
vv34:4.1: Sāhaṃ kāyassa bhedāya vippamuttā tato cutā Nimmānaratidevānaṃ upapannā sahavyatan ti. || ||
vv34:5.1: Pahūtakatakalyāṇā te deve yanti pāṇino yesaṃ tvaṃ kittayissasi Subhadde jātim attano. || ||
vv34:6.1: Kathaṃ tvaṃ kena vaṇṇena kena vā anusāsitā kīdisen' eva dānena subbatena yasassinī || ||
vv34:7.1: Yasaṃ etādisaṃ pattā visesaṃ vipulam ajjhatā devate pucchitācikkha kissa kammass' idaṃ phalan ti. || ||
vv34:8.1: Aṭṭh' eva piṇḍapātāni yaṃ dānaṃ adadaṃ pure dakkhiṇeyyassa saṅghassa pasannā sehi pāṇihi,
vv34:10.1: Ahaṃ tayā bahutare bhikkhū saññate brahmacārino tappesiṃ annapānena pasannā sehi pāṇihi
vv34:11.1: tayā bahutaraṃ datvā hīnakāyūpagā ahaṃ. || || Kathaṃ tvaṃ appataraṃ datvā visesaṃ vipulam ajjhagā devate pucchitācikkha kissa kammass' idaṃ phalan ti. || ||
vv34:12.1: Manobhāvaniyo bhikkhu sandiṭṭho me pure ahu tāhaṃ bhattena nimantesiṃ Revataṃ atta-naṭṭhamaṃ. || ||
vv34:13.1: So me atthapurekkhāro anukampāya Revato: saṅghe dehī ti maṃ voca tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ kariṃ. || ||
vv34:14.1: Sā dakkhiṇā saṅghagatā appameyye patiṭṭhitā, puggalesu tayā dinnaṃ na taṃ tava mahapphalan ti. || ||
vv34:15.1: Idān' evāhaṃ jānāmi saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ sāhaṃ gantvā manussattaṃ vadaññū vītamaccharā saṅghe dānāni dassāmi appamattā punappunan ti. || ||
vv34:16.1: Kā esā devatā bhadde tayā mantayate saha sabbe deve Tāvatiṃse vaṇṇena atirocatī ti. || ||
vv34:17.1: Manussabhūtā devinda pubbe mānusake bhave sahabhariyā ca me āsi bhaginī ca kaniṭṭhikā saṅghe dānāni datvāna katapuññā virocatī ti. || ||
vv34:18.1: Dhammena pubbe bhaginī tayā bhadde virocati yaṃ saṅghamhi appameyye patiṭṭhāpesi dakkhiṇaṃ. || ||
vv34:19.1: Pucchito hi mayā buddho Gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate vipākaṃ saṃvibhāgassa yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ. || ||
vv34:20.1: Yajamānānaṃ manussānaṃ puññapekkhāna pāṇinaṃ karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, || ||
vv34:21.1: Taṃ me buddho viyākāsi jānaṃ kammaphalaṃ sakaṃ vipākaṃ saṃvibhāgassa yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ. || ||
vv34:22.1: Cattāro ca paṭipannā cattāro ca phale ṭhitā esa saṅgho ujubhūto paññāsīlasamāhito. || ||
vv34:23.1: Yajamānānaṃ manussānaṃ puññapekkhāna pāṇinaṃ karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ. || ||
vv34:24.1: Eso hi saṅgho vipulo mahaggato es' appameyyo udadhīva sāgaro ete hi seṭṭhā naravīrasāvakā pabhaṅkarā dhammam udīrayanti. || ||
vv34:25.1: Tesaṃ sudinnaṃ suhutaṃ suyiṭṭhaṃ ye saṅgham uddissa dadanti dānaṃ sā dakkhiṇā saṅghagatā patiṭṭhitā mahapphalā lokavidūna vaṇṇitā. || ||
vv34:26.1: Etādisaṃ yaññam anussarantā ye vedajātā vicaranti loke vineyya maccheramalaṃ samūlaṃ aninditā saggam upenti ṭhānan ti. || ||
